verdict.rationale: PlanetScale ships an official, documented CLI (`pscale`). It manages databases and branches, opens secure shells, surfaces Insights and handles SSO. It also explicitly supports agent use through non-interactive SQL (`pscale sql`) for agents and scripts, and the changelog shows ongoing CLI feature additions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of CLI use in agent workflows, and explicit evidence of machine-readable (e.g. JSON) output modes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Run non-interactive SQL for agents and scripts (`pscale sql`)
Create, delete and list your Vitess, Neki, and Postgres databases and branches
Organization administrators can now enable and manage SSO from the CLI with pscale org sso.
